description: This file defines the 'File' class within the 'Opencart\System\Library\Session' namespace. It manages session data stored in files, including reading, writing, destroying, and obtaining garbage collection of session files. The class interacts with session files stored on disk, using JSON encoding for data serialization.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A class for managing session data stored in files within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with the registry's configuration object.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads session data from a file based on session ID, returning the decoded array of session variables.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes session data to a file, encoding the data as JSON.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the session file associated with the given session ID.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by removing expired session files based on configured probabilities and expiry time.
